title: nan
authors: Wang Z.; Shi D.; Qiu C.; Jin S.; Li T.; Qiao Z.; Chen Y.
key_contribution: Presents VecMapLocNet, a vision-based UAV localization method using vector maps and cross-modal matching for GNSS-denied environments, validated across seven cities and in real-world trials.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
